title: JPYC Secures ¥1.78 Billion in Series B First Close to Cement Status as Japan’s Default Stablecoin Infrastructure
tags: JPYC Bridges the Gap to Retail: Yen-Pegged Stablecoin to Power Touch Payments via Japan’s National ID SystemJPYC, the prominent Japanese Yen-pegged stablecoin, is set to undergo a significant stress test in the physical retail environment, moving beyond the digital realm to power real-world transactions through Japan’s My Number Card system. In a move that signals the increasing convergence of Web3 assets and traditional payment infrastructure,Japan FinTech ObserverNorbert Gehrke
